title: ze_surf_facility_v2_3
description: You escape from the Zombies, but there is no running only surfing! Well, there is some running, here and there. ------------------ New in V2.3 - Nerfed the ending to 1 minute from 1.5 minutes - Added song to the map. No more akward silence - Other minor changes **Features** - Tutorial Level - Automatic Surf Settings - Supports mode where zombie is not sent back to spawn - AFK killer - Noob friendly, retry and move up if you fail. No fall damage - A whole new stage! Racing! - 3 stages not including tutorial to surf - 18 different combinations with the randomized stage selection - Lighted map! - 6 minutes of pure adrenaline - Surf Boards -First zombies to finish the final stage get 150% speed! - Teamwork and communication required!
